scope.note: Targets are not proof of source availability or publication. Mark a paper covered only after opening and checking the relevant official UPSC document.

publication_policy.official_question_text: Publish only after confirming wording and paper metadata against the official UPSC PDF. Check copyright and reuse conditions before reproducing full question text; link to the UPSC document where appropriate.
publication_policy.answers: Do not claim an official answer key unless UPSC has published one. Label independently written explanations as editorial.
